name: headless-agent
description: Run a headless CLI agent (Claude Code, Codex) once in a folder under a profile (HA_PROFILE, HA_ROOT, HA_PROMPT; optional HA_MCP_URL with HA_MCP_TOOLS). The runner enforces read-only mode, gives an MCP server only as a private config file limited to the allowed tools, and prints one JSON result with the agent's result line. run-context accepts model JSON on stdin and stages a searchable index with per-net files.
